dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY-heavy structure and CALL to ORCMCPSUB

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — patient registration confirmation screen (確認画面1, WID1)
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles the confirmation screen (WID1) for patient registration, responding to LINK and PUTG/CLICKED events to navigate back or register via MCP window transitions. It calls ORCMCPSUB to perform window PUT operations.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (41 total) for screen and linkage area definitions
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-included areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
CALL to ORCMCPSUB for MCP window management
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP/latin-1 (mojibake visible)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP middleware
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING with multiple linkage parameters
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The file is part of the open-source JMA ORCA project. The 41 COPY statements and only 1 PIC clause indicate most data definitions are in copybooks. The program is a thin event-dispatch shell typical of ORCA screen programs.
